заранее информировать кого-либо об опасности или некоем событии; сообщать некую информацию до того момента, как она может оказаться полезной

examples.text: О таких вещах, конечно, следовало бы предупреждать приезжих заранее, да разве всё упомнишь?

glosses: предпринимать меры, направленные на недопущение какого-либо события

examples.text: Это были офицеры личной охраны из специального отдела КГБ, их задача была оберегать мою жизнь, а также предупреждать нежелательные контакты (последнее не скрывалось).

glosses: To make (someone) aware of (something impending); especially:
To make (someone) aware of impending danger, evil, etc.

examples.text: We waved a flag to warn the oncoming traffic about the accident.
I phoned to warn him of the road closure.

glosses: To make (someone) aware of (something impending); especially:
To notify or inform (someone, about something).

examples.text: I warned him he'd be getting a huge box of birthday presents from me.

glosses: To make (someone) aware of (something impending); especially:
To summon (someone) to or inform of a formal meeting or duty.

examples.text: The sheriff warned her to appear in court.
Committee being warned these following were absent or short …
The people had been invited to the funeral, or warnt, by a special messenger a few days before the funeral took place.
[...] the plaintiff fraudulently warned the meeting for November 15, giving only five days' notice [...]

glosses: To make (someone) aware of (something impending); especially:
To make a sound (e.g. clicking or whirring) indicating that it is about to strike or chime (an hour).

examples.text: Hark! the clock is warning ten;
No, not a word more, Andrew; the clock has warned for nine, and I am off.

The clock warned, and the hands pointed to a few minutes before the hour. The preacher looked towards it. "And, as you sit here," he cried," the Old Year is dragging out its last moments and the New Year is coming up —"

glosses: To caution or admonish (someone) against unwise or unacceptable behaviour.

examples.text: Don't let me catch you running in the corridor again, I warn you.
He was warned against crossing the railway tracks at night.

glosses: To advise or order to go or stay away.

examples.text: A sign warns trespassers off/away from the site.

glosses: To give warning.

examples.text: then Iames Cephas and Iohn [...] agreed with vs that we shuld preache amonge the Hethen and they amonge the Iewes: warnynge only that we shulde remember the poore.
She is his deepest innocence in spaces of bough and hay before wishes were given a different name to warn that they might not come true [...].
She warned that he was seriously thinking of withdrawing his offer to part the waters, ‘so that all you'll get at the Arabian Sea is a saltwater bath [...]’.
Every country has its resident experts who warn that imported television will destroy the national consciousness and replace it with Dallas, The Waltons, Star Trek and Twin Peaks.

glosses: To warn in advance.

examples.text: And ſure, although it was invented to eaſe his mynde of griefe, there be a number of caveats therein to forewarne other young gentlemen to foreſtand with good government their folowing yl fortunes; […]
“I came down like a wolf on the fold, didn’t I ? Why didn’t I telephone ? Strategy, my dear boy, strategy. This is a surprise attack, and I’d no wish that the garrison, forewarned, should escape.[…]”

glosses: Dar noticia de alguna cosa.
Advertir, aconsejar.

examples.text: Además, la citada voz femenina avisó: “Tened cuidado con las líneas eléctricas”.

Servet leyó el libro de Calvino e hizo anotaciones muy críticas en los márgenes del libro, devolviéndole la copia corregida, lo que desagradó enormemente al reformador, quien avisó que si Servet ponía los pies en Ginebra “no saldría vivo de ella”.

glosses: Notar, observar.

examples.text: Parecióme que en aquel instante desperté de la simpleza en que, como niño, dormido estaba. Dije entre mí: “Verdad dice éste, que me cumple avivar el ojo y avisar, pues solo soy, y pensar cómo me sepa valer”.

glosses: Instruirse.
Dirigir la atención u observar, reparar en algo.

examples.text: No había advertido que estabas llamando.

glosses: Hacer que alguien dirija la atención u observe. Hacer notar.

examples.text: Ya les advertí de su error.

glosses: Dar consejo o prevenir.

examples.text: Te advierto que las cosas no marchan bien por aquí.

glosses: Hacer una advertencia, a veces amenazante.

examples.text: Te advierto que no vuelvas por aquí.
